dimensions.assessment: Affects eligible veterans seeking to purchase cooperative housing units, participating lenders, and realtors.
dimensions.evidence: loan guarantee for purchase of residential cooperative housing units

dimensions.assessment: Provides financial backing and loan guarantees for co-op purchases, alongside an additional 3.25 percent loan fee.
dimensions.evidence: amount of the fee shall be... plus 3.25 percent of the total amount of the loan

dimensions.assessment: Involves federal loan guarantees and fee collections for cooperative housing purchases, though total fiscal scale depends on borrower participation.
dimensions.evidence: guarantee up to 25% of the amount of the loan for loans exceeding $144,000

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 to make co-op loan guarantees permanent, treat co-op shares as residential property, and establish fee structures.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to provide for the improvement of the Department of Veterans Affairs loan guarantee

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change reviving and sustaining the VA co-op loan guarantee authority.
dimensions.evidence: revives and makes permanent the authority of the Department of Veterans Affairs

importance_detail.rationale: This bill revives and makes permanent the VA home loan guarantee program for residential cooperative housing units, sets a specific loan fee rate, and requires advertising and guidance.
